title: Missing asset index check allows any token to mint shares
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The deposit function in the HyperVaultRouter contract performs a check to ensure that the deposited token is supported via the _isAssetSupported method, using the asset index retrieved from $.assetIndexes[asset]. However, this check is flawed due to the following logic:  ```solidity         uint64 assetIndex_ = $.assetIndexes[asset];         require(_isAssetSupported($, assetIndex_), Errors.COLLATERAL_NOT_SUPPORTED());  ```` If a token is not registered (i.e., not added via addAsset), the mapping $.assetIndexes[asset] returns
